node.statement: Inverse norm and quantified conclusion. For arbitrary Y in the codomain of T_n, set Z=T_n^(-1)Y, whose existence is node 1.4.1. Node 1.3 gives ||Y||=||T_n(Z)||>=(1-A*e)||Z||, hence ||T_n^(-1)Y||<=||Y||/(1-A*e). Taking the supremum gives ||T_n^(-1)||<=1/(1-A*e). For x=A*e in [0,1/2], 1/(1-x)<=1+2*x, so this is at most 1+2*A*e=1+C_rect*e. Node 1.1 fixed arbitrary admissible data and arbitrary n and supplied universal C_rect,e_rect; therefore the asserted estimate and bijectivity hold for every amplification and establish the root.
